description: Alex Example, 29, a salaried product analyst renting a studio in San Francisco. Chase checking and Freedom card, Ally online savings with an automatic monthly transfer, an Amex for dining. Pays both cards in full. Splits dinners over Venmo and Zelle, changes subscriptions, buys a laptop and furniture, and visits New York.
